notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.content:
- set game on pause when gamepad disconnects
- lower initial graphics configuration on Steam Deck
- fixes for Transporter on the "Breezy Journey" level
- fixes for Clunker and Gangsteer on the "Dinosaur Ride" level
- fix car reset in "Crash Dummies" level
- fix collider on the column in the High Sky level
- cheaper cost for Breezy Journey level
- fix achievements with stats
- tweak level completion times
- fix trees having particles even after destruction
